about.title: Hais Txog Peb
about.subtitle: Khw Khaub Ncaws Hmoob tau tsim los ntawm txoj kev hlub rau Hmoob kev cai, kom tuav tseg cov paj ntaub uas yog Hmoob tug rau tej tub ki mus ib txhis
about.storyText: Peb pib los ntawm ib lub khw me me hauv Vientiane, xaws thiab paj ntaub khaub ncaws Hmoob rau cov neeg hauv zej zog. Niaj hnub no peb loj hlob mus ua ib lub khw online, coj Hmoob paj ntaub qhov zoo nkauj mus txog txhua tus neeg thoob teb chaws. Txhua daim khoom raug xaiv thiab kuaj kom zoo ua ntej xa mus txog koj txhais tes.

1.name: Cev Khaub Ncaws Poj Niam Hmoob Ib Txwm
1.desc: Cev khaub ncaws poj niam Hmoob ib txwm, xaws paj ntaub tes txhua kauj ruam, nrog daim tiab nthws thiab daim sev paj ntaub qub. Zoo rau noj peb caug thiab hnub tseem ceeb.

2.name: Tsho Hmoob Xaws Paj Ntaub Tes
2.desc: Tsho Hmoob xaws paj ntaub tes 100%, cov paj zoo nkauj heev. Ntaub paj rwb zoo, hnav xis nyob, thiab yooj yim hnav nrog khaub ncaws niaj hnub.

3.name: Daim Tiab Hmoob Paj Qub
3.desc: Daim tiab Hmoob nthws nrog paj qub, xim ci ntsa iab. Ntaub zoo nkauj, ncig ua si zoo heev — zoo rau seev cev thiab thaij duab.

4.name: Cev Khaub Ncaws Txiv Neej Hmoob
4.desc: Ib cev khaub ncaws txiv neej Hmoob: tsho, ris, thiab siv. Ntaub dub tuab nrog paj ntaub zoo nkauj, hnav tau meej mom heev.

5.name: Kaus Mom Me Nyuam Hmoob
5.desc: Kaus mom me nyuam Hmoob zoo nkauj heev, xaws paj me me nrog cov qws xim ci. Muaj ntau qhov loj xaiv.

6.name: Txoj Siv Nyiaj Hmoob
6.desc: Txoj siv nyiaj Hmoob tseeb, ntaus tes los ntawm cov kws txawj, cov paj zoo heev. Ib yam khoom qub tuav tseg tau ntau tiam neeg.

7.name: Phuam Paj Ntaub Hmoob
7.desc: Phuam looj caj dab paj ntaub Hmoob, mos thiab sov, hnav tau txhua lub caij. Ib qho khoom plig muaj nqis rau peb kev cai.

8.name: Cev Khaub Ncaws Me Ntxhais Hmoob
8.desc: Ib cev khaub ncaws me ntxhais Hmoob nrog kaus mom thiab khoom dai. Xim ci zoo nkauj heev — zoo rau noj peb caug Hmoob.
